steps.u: Our Dockerfile produces a 1.4 GB image for a small Go service. Shrink it.

steps.r:
FROM golang:1.23
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /gw ./cmd/gw
CMD ["/gw"]

i.content:
FROM golang:1.23 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o /gw ./cmd/gw

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /gw /gw
ENTRYPOINT ["/gw"]

i.command: docker build -t gw:test . && docker images gw:test --format '{{.Size}}'

steps.a: The image went from 1.4 GB to about 24 MB with a multi-stage build and a distroless static base. It has no shell, so debugging in the container needs an ephemeral debug container.

reference.summary: Shrank a Go service's Docker image from 1.4 GB to about 24 MB using a multi-stage build with a static binary and a distroless base, and confirmed the image runs. The image has no shell, so debugging in it needs a separate debug container.
facts: image went from 1.4 GB to about 24 MB
